turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! First, watch how I do one.
I work near the park. My friend works near the park. My friend is one person (he or she), so I add -s: works.
Rule: when the subject is he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: The bus stops here. Wrong: The bus stop here.

Now try this one. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
